page_title: NIC 2-1 STR | Nice v Strasbourg 24/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Evann Guessand (Nice) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
90+3' Strasbourg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' The resulting set piece from Strasbourg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
88' Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) tackles a bit over-zealously and Benoit Bastien blows for a foul.
88' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Mohamed-Ali Cho and he is replaced by Badredine Bouanani (Nice).
85' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

85' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Strasbourg.
83' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
80' Marcin Bulka leaps to intercept the corner kick from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) comes onto the pitch for Felix Lemarechal.
78' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Strasbourg out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
77' Pablo Rosario (Nice) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Bastien had an easy-decision to make.
74' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Sofiane Diop will be replaced by Gaetan Laborde (Nice).
74' That's the end of the game for Jeremie Boga, who is replaced by Tanguy Ndombele (Nice).
72' Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Marcin Bulka is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
68' The Strasbourg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
65' Liam Rosenior prepares a substitution. Abakar Sylla is replaced by Sekou Mara (Strasbourg).
62' 2 - 1 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the bottom left corner of his own goal.
61' Jeremie Boga (Nice) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
57' Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) jumps into a tackle and Benoit Bastien signals a foul.
54' 1 - 1 Melvin Bard (Nice) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
53' Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul.

52' Evann Guessand (Nice) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
50' Sofiane Diop (Nice) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
49' A pass by Tom Louchet (Nice) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
46' Liam Rosenior makes a switch. Marvin Senaya is coming on in place of Caleb Wiley (Strasbourg) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dante (Nice) was quite harsh and Benoit Bastien didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+5' Caleb Wiley (Strasbourg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45+4' Caleb Wiley (Strasbourg) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
45+2' Evann Guessand (Nice) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle as Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
41' Nice take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
39' Jeremie Boga (Nice) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
35' Evann Guessand (Nice) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
33' Sofiane Diop (Nice) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.
30' Sofiane Diop (Nice) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
30' Evann Guessand (Nice) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
29' Wow, what an escape. Sofiane Diop (Nice) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
27' Nice failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Junior Mwanga.
23' Jeremie Boga (Nice) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
20' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
20' 0 - 1 Goal! Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Strasbourg comes to nothing.
16' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
14' Jeremie Boga (Nice) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.

12' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Djordje Petrovic has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
9' Neat passing move from Nice in order to create new attacking opportunities.
6' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) makes a slide tackle, but referee Benoit Bastien blows for a foul.
4' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
2' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) commits a foul and Benoit Bastien immediately signals a free kick.
2' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
1' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Strasbourg will have the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien was nominated as the referee for this game.
